script: Draw thick walls squeezing both ventricles. Mark the tricuspid and mitral valves closed with short bars. Draw the pulmonary and aortic valves open. Add blue and red arrows shooting out through the pulmonary artery and aorta.
issue: the rendered board has a layout fault: a connector ends in empty space at 341,202 (the full stroke runs 385,257 to 341,202), touching no label and no shape. Every arrow must join two named things and its direction must state the relation between them — delete this stroke, or attach it to what it is meant to connect

ops.teachingPoint: Draw both ventricles contracting, with the tricuspid and mitral valves closed and the pulmonary and aortic valves open. Show blood being ejected from the right ventricle into the pulmonary artery and from the left ventricle into the aorta.

export default function Animation({ sentence, sentenceProgress }) {
  const on = (k) => sentence >= k;
  const reveal = (k) => ({ opacity: on(k) ? 1 : 0, y: on(k) ? 0 : 10 });
  const draw = (k) => ({ pathLength: on(k) ? 1 : 0, opacity: on(k) ? 1 : 0 });
  const REVEAL = { duration: 0.6, ease: "easeOut" };
  const DRAW = { duration: 1.1, ease: "easeInOut" };
  const SPRING = { type: "spring", stiffness: 140, damping: 24 };
  const GLIDE = { duration: 0.35, ease: "easeOut" };

  const visualSpec = {
    subject: "Ventricular contraction",
    recognitionCues: [
      "recognizable silhouette",
      "correct relative proportions",
      "clear functional relationships"
    ],
    requiredParts: [
      "right ventricle",
      "left ventricle",
      "tricuspid valve",
      "mitral valve",
      "pulmonary valve",
      "aortic valve",
      "pulmonary artery",
      "aorta"
    ],
    relationships: [
      "blood is ejected from the right ventricle into the pulmonary artery",
      "blood is ejected from the left ventricle into the aorta"
    ],
    morphology: "front cutaway view of the two ventricles with thick muscular walls and outlet vessels",
    view: "the clearest scientifically appropriate teaching view",
    forbiddenShortcuts: [
      "generic icon",
      "unlabeled blob",
      "decorative geometry",
      "unrelated analogy object"
    ]
  };

  const boardPlan = {
    composition: "title, concise notes at left, one large front cutaway of both ventricles at center, labels at right",
    readingPath: [
      "title",
      "thick ventricular walls",
      "closed tricuspid and mitral valves",
      "open pulmonary and aortic valves",
      "blood ejection through the pulmonary artery and aorta"
    ],
    reservedRegions: [
      { name: "title", x: 56, y: 30, w: 650, h: 84 },
      { name: "notes", x: 56, y: 140, w: 274, h: 220 },
      { name: "stage", x: 350, y: 128, w: 350, h: 384 },
      { name: "labels", x: 710, y: 128, w: 234, h: 384 }
    ]
  };

  const ink = "#1b2440";
  const secondary = "#5b6478";
  const tissue = "#c2544d";
  const bloodBlue = "#3f6fb5";
  const bloodRed = "#c94f4b";
  const teal = "#0f766e";
  const accent = "#d97706";
  const squeeze = sentence === 0 ? 0.02 * smooth(phase(sentenceProgress, 0.2, 0.9)) : 0.02;

  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 1000 560">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="1000" height="560" fill="#fbfbf8" />
      <defs>
        <linearGradient id="heartMuscle" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
          <stop offset="0" stopColor="#f7c8c0" />
          <stop offset="1" stopColor="#d98278" />
        </linearGradient>
        <linearGradient id="wallDeep" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
          <stop offset="0" stopColor="#f2aaa1" />
          <stop offset="1" stopColor="#bd5a54" />
        </linearGradient>
        <linearGradient id="vesselBlue" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
          <stop offset="0" stopColor="#dcebf8" />
          <stop offset="1" stopColor="#9ebfe2" />
        </linearGradient>
        <linearGradient id="vesselRed" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
          <stop offset="0" stopColor="#f5d5d2" />
          <stop offset="1" stopColor="#d98b86" />
        </linearGradient>
        <filter id="soft" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
          <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="3" stdDeviation="4" floodColor="#0f172a" floodOpacity="0.14" />
        </filter>
        <marker id="blueHead" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto">
          <path d="M0 0 L10 5 L0 10 z" fill={bloodBlue} />
        </marker>
        <marker id="redHead" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto">
          <path d="M0 0 L10 5 L0 10 z" fill={bloodRed} />
        </marker>
      </defs>

      <motion.g initial={false} animate={reveal(0)} transition={REVEAL}>
        <text x="56" y="70" fontSize="32" fontWeight="800" fill={ink}>Ventricular contraction</text>
      </motion.g>

      <motion.g initial={false} animate={reveal(0)} transition={REVEAL}>
        <circle cx="63" cy="163" r="5" fill={tissue} />
        <text x="78" y="170" fontSize="21" fontWeight="600" fill={ink}>Thick walls squeeze</text>
      </motion.g>

      <motion.g initial={false} animate={reveal(1)} transition={REVEAL}>
        <circle cx="63" cy="219" r="5" fill={accent} />
        <text x="78" y="226" fontSize="21" fontWeight="600" fill={ink}>Valves closed</text>
      </motion.g>

      <motion.g initial={false} animate={reveal(2)} transition={REVEAL}>
        <circle cx="63" cy="275" r="5" fill={teal} />
        <text x="78" y="282" fontSize="21" fontWeight="600" fill={ink}>Outflow valves open</text>
      </motion.g>

      <motion.g initial={false} animate={reveal(3)} transition={REVEAL}>
        <circle cx="63" cy="331" r="5" fill={bloodRed} />
        <text x="78" y="338" fontSize="21" fontWeight="600" fill={ink}>Blood is ejected</text>
      </motion.g>

      <motion.g initial={false} animate={reveal(0)} transition={REVEAL} filter="url(#soft)">
        <motion.g
          initial={false}
          animate={{ scale: 1 - squeeze, x: squeeze * 260, y: squeeze * 105 }}
          transition={SPRING}
          style={{ transformOrigin: "520px 333px" }}
        >
          <path
            d="M514 220 C487 183 438 169 405 195 C371 221 369 273 377 326 L392 438 C397 475 429 491 465 466 L514 425 Z"
            fill="url(#heartMuscle)"
            stroke={tissue}
            strokeWidth="2.5"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
          />
          <path
            d="M514 220 C541 183 590 169 623 195 C657 221 659 273 651 326 L636 438 C631 475 599 491 563 466 L514 425 Z"
            fill="url(#heartMuscle)"
            stroke={tissue}
            strokeWidth="2.5"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
          />
          <path
            d="M396 311 C405 271 432 242 470 244 C493 245 505 263 514 283 L514 425 L465 466 C429 491 397 475 392 438 Z"
            fill="url(#wallDeep)"
            opacity="0.28"
          />
          <path
            d="M632 311 C623 271 596 242 558 244 C535 245 523 263 514 283 L514 425 L563 466 C599 491 631 475 636 438 Z"
            fill="url(#wallDeep)"
            opacity="0.28"
          />
          <path d="M514 221 C503 267 503 355 514 425" fill="none" stroke="#a84543" strokeWidth="2.5" />
          <path d="M417 224 C402 272 407 338 422 401 M611 224 C626 272 621 338 606 401" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" strokeWidth="3" opacity="0.42" />
        </motion.g>
      </motion.g>

      <motion.g initial={false} animate={reveal(0)} transition={{ ...REVEAL, delay: 0.35 }}>
        <path d="M431 278 C443 263 463 260 480 273 L489 286 C474 299 449 300 431 278 Z" fill="#f7c8c0" stroke={tissue} strokeWidth="2" />
        <path d="M598 278 C586 263 566 260 549 273 L540 286 C555 299 580 300 598 278 Z" fill="#f7c8c0" stroke={tissue} strokeWidth="2" />
      </motion.g>

      <motion.g initial={false} animate={reveal(1)} transition={REVEAL}>
        <path d="M431 278 L480 273 M598 278 L549 273" fill="none" stroke={accent} strokeWidth="6" strokeLinecap="round" />
      </motion.g>

      <motion.g initial={false} animate={reveal(2)} transition={REVEAL}>
        <path d="M431 205 C426 174 428 148 440 128 C449 113 463 111 472 124 L482 151 L476 202 Z" fill="url(#vesselBlue)" stroke={bloodBlue} strokeWidth="2.5" />
        <path d="M557 202 L547 151 L557 124 C566 111 580 113 589 128 C601 148 603 174 598 205 Z" fill="url(#vesselRed)" stroke={bloodRed} strokeWidth="2.5" />
        <path d="M445 132 C440 154 441 175 447 194 M575 132 C580 154 579 175 573 194" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" strokeWidth="2" opacity="0.55" />
        <path d="M442 211 L475 211 M557 211 L590 211" fill="none" stroke={teal} strokeWidth="5" strokeLinecap="round" />
      </motion.g>

      <motion.path
        d="M451 276 C430 245 421 213 421 178"
        fill="none"
        stroke={bloodBlue}
        strokeWidth="3"
        strokeLinecap="round"
        markerEnd="url(#blueHead)"
        initial={false}
        animate={draw(3)}
        transition={DRAW}
      />
      <motion.path
        d="M577 276 C598 245 609 213 609 178"
        fill="none"
        stroke={bloodRed}
        strokeWidth="3"
        strokeLinecap="round"
        markerEnd="url(#redHead)"
        initial={false}
        animate={draw(3)}
        transition={{ ...DRAW, delay: 0.25 }}
      />

      <motion.circle
        cx={lerp(451, 421, phase(sentenceProgress, 0.15, 0.8))}
        cy={lerp(276, 178, phase(sentenceProgress, 0.15, 0.8))}
        r="5"
        fill={bloodBlue}
        initial={false}
        animate={{ opacity: sentence === 3 ? 1 : 0 }}
        transition={GLIDE}
      />
      <motion.circle
        cx={lerp(577, 609, phase(sentenceProgress, 0.2, 0.85))}
        cy={lerp(276, 178, phase(sentenceProgress, 0.2, 0.85))}
        r="5"
        fill={bloodRed}
        initial={false}
        animate={{ opacity: sentence === 3 ? 1 : 0 }}
        transition={GLIDE}
      />

      <motion.path d="M385 257 C365 242 350 224 341 202" fill="none" stroke={accent} strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round"
        initial={false} animate={draw(1)} transition={DRAW} />
      <motion.path d="M643 257 C663 242 678 224 687 202" fill="none" stroke={accent} strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round"
        initial={false} animate={draw(1)} transition={{ ...DRAW, delay: 0.25 }} />

      <motion.g initial={false} animate={reveal(3)} transition={REVEAL}>
        <path d="M399 441 C420 451 441 456 463 457" fill="none" stroke={tissue} strokeWidth="1.5" opacity="0.75" />
        <path d="M629 441 C608 451 587 456 565 457" fill="none" stroke={tissue} strokeWidth="1.5" opacity="0.75" />
      </motion.g>

      <BoardLabels side="right" sentence={sentence} sentenceProgress={sentenceProgress} labels={[
        { text: "tricuspid", x: 455, y: 278, sentence: 1 },
        { text: "pulmonary artery", x: 455, y: 155, sentence: 3 },
        { text: "aorta", x: 575, y: 155, sentence: 3 }
      ]} />
    </svg>
  );
}
